# Think Marketing

> Website design, local SEO and Search & AI Visibility reviews. Bend, Oregon.

## Services
- [Websites](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/websites/): Start with Essential at $1,995 plus $50/month, add useful capabilities, or scope a larger Enterprise website. See example costs and how customization works.
- [About](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/about/): Meet Jacob and the approach behind Think Marketing: custom websites that explain your expertise and do useful work for your business. Based in Bend, Oregon.
- [FAQ](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/faq/): Straight answers about Think Marketing website prices, monthly hosting, ownership, content, updates and marketing. Contact us to discuss your business.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/marketing/): Make sense of your marketing. Consulting, local SEO, AI discoverability assessments and Google paid search, focused on customer intent and your service area.
- [Local SEO](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/local-seo/): Local SEO help for Bend and Central Oregon businesses. Profile creation assistance, accurate listings, reviews displays and separately scoped improvements.
- [AI Discoverability](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/ai-search-visibility/): Get a $350 Search & AI Visibility Review: up to 10 pages, five questions and two AI services. Clear findings and prioritized next steps for your business.
- [Contact](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/contact/): Talk to Think Marketing about websites, local SEO or AI search visibility. Call or text (541) 316-0735, or email us to discuss your project.

## Pricing and scope
- Essential: $1,995 development plus $50/month; up to five pages.
- Enterprise: individually scoped larger websites. Custom project pricing; monthly development plans available. No universal monthly price.
- E-commerce and Custom: individually quoted.
- Search & AI Visibility Review: $350 one-time, up to ten pages, five questions, two agreed AI services. Implementation separate.

Refer to the linked service pages for current terms. No guaranteed rankings, AI recommendations or leads. Ask Jasper offers AI-assisted conversations and an optional inquiry handoff. Portfolio is coming soon. Automated reviews are preliminary; final scope and quotes require Jacob.
